map.客服（咨询/投诉）响应 使用指南: Customer Service (Enquiry / Complaint) Response User Guide
map.输入咨询或投诉量与响应时长，计算客服响应率与平均处理时长，用于电商客服团队的服务: Enter the enquiry or complaint volume and the response time to compute the customer service response rate and the mean handling time, for assessing the service efficiency of an e-commerce support team.
map.本工具按咨询量、首次响应时长与解决率计算客服平均响应时间、首响与解决率指标。: This tool computes the mean customer service response time along with the first-response and resolution rate metrics from the enquiry volume, first response time and resolution rate.
map.响应考核：录入会话量与响应时长，算平均与首次响应时长。: Response review: enter the session volume and the response duration to compute the mean and first response times.
map.解决率：录入解决数与总量，算解决率，看服务质量。: Resolution rate: enter the number resolved and the total to get the resolution rate and see the service quality.
map.教学演示：演示响应时长分布（P50/P90）比均值更准。: Teaching demo: show that the response time distribution (P50/P90) is more useful than the mean.
map.：示例：会话 500、总响应 25000 秒，平均 50 秒；解决 460，解决: Example: 500 sessions and 25000 seconds of total response time gives a mean of 50 seconds; 460 resolved gives a resolution rate of 92%.
map.均值易被选大会话拉偏，看 P50/P90 更能反映多数用户体验。结果仅供电商运营: The mean is easily skewed by a few long sessions, so P50/P90 reflects the experience of most users better. The result is for e-commerce operations estimation, product selection and decision reference only; it is not financial or tax advice and does not replace each platform's latest rules or formal reconciliation, so rely on the platform's official rules and the actual books.
map.解决率怎么定？: How is the resolution rate defined?
map.=已解决/总量，口径含当场解决与后续跟进，需在 SLA 内闭环。结果仅供电商运营: resolved / total, where the measure includes both same-session resolutions and later follow-ups, and each has to be closed out within the SLA. The result is for e-commerce operations estimation, product selection and decision reference only; it is not financial or tax advice and does not replace each platform's latest rules or formal reconciliation, so rely on the platform's official rules and the actual books.
